cc_updates.body: Added support for Amazon Bedrock powered by Mantle, changed default effort level from medium to high for various users, added compact Slack headers with clickable links, and fixed multiple issues including 429 rate-limit responses and Console login failures on macOS.

Added forceRemoteSettingsRefresh policy setting, interactive Bedrock setup wizard, per-model and cache-hit breakdown to /cost, and fixed subagent spawning issues, prompt-type Stop hooks failures, and tool input validation problems.

Added MCP tool result persistence override via annotation, disableSkillShellExecution setting, multi-line prompts in deep links, and plugin executables support under bin/. Fixed transcript chain breaks and keyboard shortcuts on multiple terminals.
